test_case.test_name: Five-cycle per-port DPU OOB link-flap and recovery
test_case.purpose: Demonstrate each mapped DPU OOB port becomes unavailable in the approved down state, recovers reachability in the up state for five complete indexed cycles, and finishes with unchanged configuration and stable management service.
required_package: DPU OS interface/MAC/address/route, physical connector, switch/peer port and ping source/destination map
Approved administrative link command or physical cable/fixture mechanism per port
Five-cycle down/up dwell, carrier deadline, ping count/interval/timeout and allowed-loss oracle
Independent RShim/serial/BMC/alternate-management path and maintenance window
Qualified operator, protected per-cycle evidence and original-configuration restoration plan
test_case.test_command: With independent management verified, capture target-bound interface/address/route/carrier/counter baseline. A qualified operator performs the approved down then up action on one mapped OOB port for exactly five indexed cycles; automation timestamps complete link/carrier and bounded ping results for each down/up state. Stop on anomaly, then verify original configuration, route, carrier, counters and BMC/OOB reachability after the fifth cycle.
test_case.expected_result: For every mapped port and each of five cycles, the down state is observed within the signed deadline and the mapped ping target is unreachable under the declared oracle; the up state returns within deadline and satisfies ping/loss limits; no address/route drift or disqualifying network/platform error occurs; final OOB service is stable and normal.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires all ten state transitions per port, cycle-indexed carrier/ping evidence, exact topology provenance and final unchanged/restored state. A static `ip` snapshot, one successful ping, LED observation or fewer than five cycles cannot pass.
safety_gate: Prove independent management and console recovery before flapping any OOB port
Operate only the mapped port and approved administrative/physical mechanism; do not alter address, route or unrelated interfaces
Preserve logs and monitor management reachability, routes, carrier, counters and errors each cycle
Stop immediately on wrong port, unexpected network impact, configuration drift or failed up transition; restore once under operator control and never auto-retry
expected_evidence: Baseline configuration, alternate-access proof and original state hash
Five indexed down/up carrier, command/operator action, timestamps and ping results per port
Per-cycle counter/error deltas and any physical fixture evidence
Final configuration diff, carrier/routes/services and BMC/OOB reachability
Preserved logs, recovery if needed and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: If a port fails to return or management is lost, stop the sequence, use the independent RShim/serial/BMC path, restore only the approved interface/cable state once, verify routes/address/services and preserve the failed-cycle evidence. Do not continue remaining cycles or retry automatically.
